description: Processed numerical data for: Interpreting differential settlement mechanisms at railway bridge–embankment transitions is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Chumyen Panudech, Charoenwong Chonlatis. This dataset contains processed numerical values used to generate the figures and settlement analyses reported in the associated journal article. The data support transparency and reproducibility of the reported results. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
